setup: Copy only this V2 folder into review-delivery of an isolated worktree at the exact application SHA being reviewed. Use existing reviewed lockfile dependencies; no APIs or credentials.
warning: policy.test imports the fixture from cases.test so Bun also registers the three compatibility cases; expect11 total tests in policy invocation. Preserve per-test results, not only aggregate totals.
scope: Code-only synthetic cases and sanitised review result; no issuer files, screenshots, environment files or actual financial data; no design changes.
